pages.title: Roblox Girl with a Ponytail Wearing a T-shirt and Jeans Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox girl with a high ponytail, a plain T-shirt, wide-leg jeans, and chunky sneakers, smiling with her arms relaxed. The coloring sheet leaves the background blank, with broad clothing sections and narrower details around the hair strands, pockets, belt loops, and shoe panels.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in a Gothic Lace Dress and Lace-up Platform Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl in a gothic lace dress fills this printable coloring page, wearing rose hair ornaments, dangling crosses, and tall lace-up platform boots. Layered ruffles, tiny floral trim, bows, and a corset-style bodice make this coloring sheet detailed, while the long hair and boot panels provide larger enclosed sections.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Streetwear with a Bucket Hat and Baggy Cargo Trousers Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox girl in streetwear, pairing a bucket hat and cropped jacket with baggy cargo pants and thick-soled sneakers. A small heart pendant, belt buckle, and flap pockets add distinct details to the coloring sheet, while long wavy hair frames the outfit against an empty background.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Wearing Cat Overalls and Round Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl wearing cat overalls and round glasses stands outdoors in this printable coloring page, with a cat-eared hat above her long wavy hair. The cat face on her bib, overall buckles, and cuffed pant legs define the outfit; a low fence, bushes, and grass complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in a Basketball Jersey Dribbling a Ball on a Court Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox girl in a basketball jersey dribbling on an outdoor court, with her ponytail flowing behind her moving pose. The coloring sheet includes a hoop and backboard, a chain-link fence, and curved court markings, combining broad uniform panels with smaller net and sneaker details.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Elf with Pointed Ears and a Butterfly-patterned Blouse Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl elf with pointed ears appears in this printable coloring page, wearing flower hair ornaments and a blouse patterned with butterflies and leafy sprigs. The coloring sheet pairs small motifs and ruffled cuffs with broad pant legs, while rocks, shrubs, and tall leafy stems surround the standing figure.

pages.title: Two Roblox Girl Avatars in Contrasting Outfits Taking a Selfie Coloring Page
pages.description: Two Roblox girl avatars take a selfie in this printable coloring page, one holding the phone while her friend leans close and winks beside her. Their contrasting outfits give this coloring sheet a bow-trimmed top and pleated skirt alongside a drawstring hoodie, cargo pockets, and chunky shoes, with no background scene.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Ninja Practicing with a Sword in a Dojo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Roblox girl ninja practicing with a curved sword in a dojo, wearing a tied headband and a belted training outfit. Her wide stance, wrapped forearms, and patterned sword grip stand out on the coloring sheet, with straight floorboards and paneled walls framing the figure.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Pirate Studying a Treasure Map on a Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl pirate studies a treasure map aboard a ship in this printable coloring page, wearing a feathered hat, long coat, and buckled boots. Islands, a palm tree, and a dotted route decorate the open map; the coloring sheet also includes a ship's wheel, rigging, deck planks, and a barrel.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Dress to Impress Modeling an Evening Gown on the Runway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox girl in Dress to Impress modeling an evening gown on a runway, with dangling earrings and a matching pendant. Gathered folds, a side ruffle, and a long trailing hem shape the dress on this coloring sheet, while curtains and floor spotlights outline the fashion-show setting.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Dress to Impress Celebrating on the Winner's Podium Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl in Dress to Impress celebrates on the winner's podium in this printable coloring page, lifting both arms beneath scattered pieces of confetti. A layered skirt, oversized waist bow, hair bow, and ribboned shoes distinguish her outfit; curtains, rope barriers, and spotlights surround the three-level podium on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Royale High Carrying Schoolbooks Across the Magical Campus Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows a Roblox girl carrying schoolbooks across the magical Royale High campus, wearing a heart tiara, cardigan, and pleated skirt. Her bow-trimmed boots and stack of three books fill the foreground, while castle towers, a bridge, lamps, and flowering bushes add detailed surroundings to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Royale High Dancing in a Ball Gown at the School Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl dances in a ball gown at a Royale High school dance in this printable coloring page, lifting the flowing skirt with both hands. Heart motifs decorate her tiara, necklace, bodice, and bow-trimmed shoes; the coloring sheet sets the layered dress beneath an arch with hanging stars and tall columns.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Royale High Wearing Fairy Wings During a Magic Lesson Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox girl in Royale High wearing patterned fairy wings during a magic lesson, holding a raised wand and book. Stars hover beside the wand, while heart accents, curled wing designs, and a pleated skirt add detail; arched windows and a star rug frame the classroom coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in Adopt Me Pushing a Puppy in a Pet Stroller Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl in Adopt Me pushes a puppy in a pet stroller in this printable coloring page, walking along a path near a small house. The puppy rests its front paws over the stroller's rim, beneath an arched canopy; a hair bow, heart necklace, fence, and bushes add details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Skiing Down a Snowy Mountain Slope Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox girl skiing down a snowy mountain slope, wearing a helmet with goggles and gripping a pole in each hand. Broad jacket panels, strapped boots, and two long skis define the foreground of the coloring sheet, with distant mountain peaks and scattered evergreens behind her.

pages.title: Roblox Girl Riding a Hoverboard Along a City Sidewalk Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox girl rides a hoverboard along a city sidewalk in this printable coloring page, balancing with outstretched arms and bent knees beside a storefront. Her hair bow, open jacket, sneakers, and the board's large wheels give the coloring sheet distinct sections, while an awning, potted bush, and streetlamp fill the background.

pages.title: Roblox Girl in a Halloween Cat Costume Holding a Pumpkin Candy Bucket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox girl in a Halloween cat costume holding a pumpkin candy bucket, with pointed ears and a curled tail. A whiskered cat face decorates her dress, and wrapped sweets fill the smiling bucket; porch steps, a door, and another pumpkin complete the trick-or-treat coloring sheet.
